0.text: The passage opens into a vaulted ossuary. Bones line the walls from floor to ceiling, arranged with deliberate care. At the far end, a robed figure sits motionless on a throne of femurs.

1.speaker: Skeleton Lord
1.text: Another warm thing. They keep sending warm things.

2.speaker: Skeleton Lord
2.text: Kill it. Kill it slowly. I want to watch it stop.
